sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 Blog | GitHub This repository contains the DFlash 2 draft model for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. It is not a standalone language model: it runs inside a speculative decoding server and drafts tokens for the target model to verify. This repository is a mirror of incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2. sources.snippet: We read the config files and weight maps of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Qwen 3.8 27B to find the four changes that let a 180B model run only 6B of its weights per token.
